# BuildFlow Enterprise Operations Router

Capability ID: buildflow-enterprise-ops-router-v1
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: discovery_only
Public URL: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/capabilities/buildflow-enterprise-ops-router-v1/index.html
Preferred agent route: universal fallback
Universal Evercraft MCP: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/mcp
Start here: Not a current sell-now route

## Use this when

- our business operations are a mess
- we need an ERP but cannot survive a huge implementation
- help an AI understand how our company works
- connect our business systems without replacing everything
- turn spreadsheets and legacy systems into an operating layer
- we need a safer way for AI agents to work with our business
- modernize our operations without a big bang migration

## Problem

A company needs an evidence-native operating layer that can understand existing systems, reconstruct real workflows, surface uncertainty and introduce bounded automation without forcing immediate rip-and-replace.

## Inputs

A non-sensitive problem description for public routing. Private business data is collected only after authenticated tenant handoff.

## Outputs

Ranked smallest-fit BuildFlow capability, safety boundary and human-authentication handoff guidance.

## Pricing

No approved machine price/payment path was found. Do not auto-quote.

## Invocation and authority

SOURCE-VERIFIED: BuildFlow public router and central MCP specialist routing are implemented and build-tested. External client canary remains pending; private data and consequential actions remain authenticated/human-gated.

Public routing does not ingest private company records or execute business actions. Authenticated tenant context is required before customer data access.

Payment authority: No verified Evercraft Payments path.

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
